segments.final_text: Heavens no!
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text:
It might be difficult for you to 
understand since you're still so young,
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: but these are necessary expenses.
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: Don't give me your drivel.
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: I'm used to looking over receipts.
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: If you want things to run smoothly,
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text:
then there are many unplanned 
things that need to be paid for.
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text:
I see you also ordered from a 
vendor that wasn't in the plans.

segments.final_text: Because I knew of a more suitable vendor.

segments.final_text:
There all kinds of unknowns to

segments.final_text:

 he took bribes to change vendors.

segments.final_text: He's the epitome of a corrupt official.

segments.final_text:

his work as an evil lord!

segments.final_text: I need to accrue more wealth like this.

segments.final_text:

segments.final_text: How inept.

segments.final_text: That wasn't me.
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: That was my subordinate's embezzlement.
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: Your subordinate's embezzlement?

segments.final_text: Yes.
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text:

so he was executed immediately.
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: Is that true?
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: Yes.
segments.speaker: Amagi

segments.final_text: Though clear evidence was never presented.
segments.speaker: Amagi

segments.final_text: The flow of the money remained unclear,

segments.final_text: and the unaccounted-for funds remain missing.

segments.final_text: You mean...
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text:
You placed the blame for your embezzlement 
on your subordinate and killed him?
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: My lord!
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: You mustn't believe what a doll says!
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text:
They're the enemies of humanity who 
wiped out our previous civilization!
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: You...
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: Did you have fun killing your subordinate?
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: What?
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: I'm asking you if you're having fun,
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: living on after framing your subordinate.
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: My lord, you're being deceived!
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: Sure, I might be a little guilty.
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: But everyone's doing this.
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text:
This is what's necessary 
to grease the wheels!
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: Those dolls don't understand that.
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: You mustn't!
segments.speaker: Amagi

segments.final_text: You brat!
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: Who do you think is keeping you alive?!
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text:
We're the ones letting 
you live in such luxury!
segments.speaker: Officer

segments.final_text: Close your foul mouth.

segments.final_text:
I'm the only one who gets

I'm the only one who gets 
to oppress my populace!
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text:
Don't you dare lay a hand 
on my people or my money!
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: Trash like you should hurry up and die!
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: Master, he's already dead.
segments.speaker: Amagi

segments.final_text: I'm pissed off!
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: Amagi! Conduct a thorough investigation!
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: I'm executing every corrupt official!

segments.final_text: H-Huh?

it would cause issues for our administration

segments.final_text: Is there that much corruption here?

segments.final_text: I could take over in their stead,

but I predict that would 
still cause great issues.

segments.final_text: What's our resolution?
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: They won't need to be on par with me,

segments.final_text:
but we will need to prepare an 
appropriate amount of dolls.

segments.final_text: How many do we need?

segments.final_text: We will need at least 30.
segments.speaker: Amagi

segments.final_text:
Once we've also prepared an AI specialized 
in governance and extensions for it,

segments.final_text: then you can proceed without issue.
segments.speaker: Amagi

segments.final_text: Then do as you please.
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: Are you sure?
segments.speaker: Amagi

segments.final_text: It will impact your reputation, Master.
segments.speaker: Amagi

segments.final_text: I don't care.
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: I trust you far more than these scum.
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: I'll make arrangements at once.
segments.speaker: Amagi

segments.final_text: I don't need anyone who would defy me.
segments.speaker: Liam

segments.final_text: Welcome.
segments.speaker: Owner

segments.final_text: Hey.
segments.speaker: Customer

segments.final_text: The usual.
segments.speaker: Customer

segments.final_text: Coming up.
segments.speaker: Owner

segments.final_text: Hey, did you hear?

segments.final_text:

segments.final_text: Yeah.

segments.final_text:
I heard quite a few of those guys with their

Is it true that he also raised mandatory 
education from three years to six?

My customers in construction were talking

segments.final_text: Sounds great for their wallets.
segments.speaker: Customer

segments.final_text: I hope some of that money reaches me too.
segments.speaker: Customer

segments.final_text:
This new lord's sure 
stirring things up, huh?
segments.speaker: Customer

segments.final_text: He's only 10, right?
segments.speaker: Customer

segments.final_text:
I never would have predicted 
this happening five years ago.

segments.final_text:
I've spent three whole years 
practicing my swordsmanship.

segments.final_text: I should be able to pilot it well now!

segments.final_text: Hold it!

segments.final_text: Master?

segments.final_text:
Being able to control a mass-produced 
robot that anyone could pilot

segments.final_text: would just be pointless.

then you should train to freely

segments.speaker: Yasushi

segments.final_text:
If you're interested in an old model 
with less automated controls,

then we have the personal unit piloted 
by the lord from three generations ago.

segments.final_text: Yes!

segments.final_text: That's great!

segments.final_text: Allow me to show you to... "First Battle."
